name: Aventi
traits: Medium Humanoid with Human and Aquatic subtypes. No ability score adjustments. Land speed 30 ft. and swim speed 30 ft. LA +0 and advancement by character class.
Amphibious (Ex). Breathes air and water without a time limit.
Swim speed grants +8 racial on Swim checks for special actions or hazards. Take 10 even when distracted or endangered. A swimming run follows a straight line.

Water Spell Power (Ex) grants +1 effective caster level for spells with the [Water] descriptor. The trait provides no spells or spell slots. A spell’s name or presence in a domain list does not supply the descriptor.
Human Blood means an Aventi counts as human for race-related effects, including human-only magic items. The Aventi traits do not grant the standard human bonus feat or extra skill points.
Common is automatic. Aquan, Elven, and Sahuagin are bonus languages. Favored class Any.
